camel_example: aliyun yike GetVideoTranslationJob --region cn-hangzhou --JobId vtj_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef --version 2026-07-07 --method POST --force
description_en: Queries the status, input parameters, and multilingual outputs of a video translation job
description_zh: 查询视频翻译任务的状态、输入参数和多语言产物
name: GetVideoTranslationJob

parameters.help_en: The video translation job ID returned by SubmitVideoTranslationJob
parameters.help_zh: SubmitVideoTranslationJob 返回的视频翻译任务 ID
parameters.name: job_id

Duration.description_en: The duration of the input video, in seconds
Duration.description_zh: 输入视频时长，单位为秒

EditingProjectId.description_en: The editing project ID for single-target-language jobs. For multi-target-language results, retrieve the value from Output.AiResult.ResultMap
EditingProjectId.description_zh: 单目标语言任务的剪辑工程 ID；多目标语言结果请从 Output.AiResult.ResultMap 获取

ErrorCode.description_en: The business error code returned when the job fails. This field is not returned when the job is not in a failed state
ErrorCode.description_zh: 任务失败时返回的业务错误码；非失败状态通常不返回

ErrorMessage.description_en: The business error message returned when the job fails. This field is not returned when the job is not in a failed state
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 任务失败时返回的业务错误信息；非失败状态通常不返回

Input.description_en: The normalized input configuration JSON string saved at submission time
Input.description_zh: 提交时归一化保存的输入配置 JSON 字符串
Input.title_zh: 输入配置 JSON 字符串

JobParameters.description_en: The normalized job parameters JSON string, including default values supplemented by the service
JobParameters.description_zh: 归一化后的任务参数 JSON 字符串，包含服务补充的默认值
JobParameters.title_zh: 任务参数 JSON 字符串

Output.description_en: The job output JSON string. On success, AiResult.ResultMap organizes the final video, subtitle, and audio outputs by target language
Output.description_zh: 任务输出 JSON 字符串。成功时 AiResult.ResultMap 按目标语言组织最终视频、字幕和音频产物
Output.title_zh: 任务输出 JSON 字符串

Status.description_en: The job status. Valid values: Created, Queuing, Executing, Finished, or Failed

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, used for Tracing Analysis and troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于链路追踪和问题排查
